big: When India buys a fighter jet, one company stands out: HAL. It makes fighters such as the Tejas, helicopters and aero-engines. The state-owned makers hold the largest share of production.

lines: HAL: fighters, helicopters and aero-engines. BEL: radars, electronic warfare, air defence and communication. BDL: missiles such as Akash and Astra. Mazagon Dock: submarines and destroyers. Cochin Shipyard built INS Vikrant. Together DPSUs and other PSUs made about 76% of FY26 production.
